findings.issue: Modernized button disables without clear feedback on first load
findings.description: If `validation.securityIssuesFixed` is undefined in the API response, the button will be disabled with reason 'Security issues must be fixed before switching', even if security checks have passed. API contract should guarantee this field is always present (0 or higher).

findings.issue: Toast message retains hardcoded parity percentage format
findings.description: The success toast on approval displays '...preserved with (${run.preservationScore}% parity)'. This is acceptable user feedback, but if `preservationScore` is undefined, the toast will display 'NaN% parity'. Verify API always includes this field.

findings.issue: Hero banner phrasing may be misinterpreted as production guarantee
findings.description: When all tests pass, the banner reads '100% behavioral parity'. This is accurate for test coverage but could be misunderstood as a guarantee of real-world equivalence including unmocked external dependencies. Consider clarifying that parity refers to golden-master test cases only.
